scope: Isolated synthetic data only; no real user profiles, credentials, local user machine or installer publication.

windowsCloudSequence.step: Check out immutable main source and install frozen dependencies on authorized Windows cloud environment
Once workspace build dependencies and runtime assets are available, produce current desktop outputs
Run existing isolated activity/layout/material interaction assertions
Extract synthetic workspace outside source repository; verify file tree/search/watch/groups/splits/reopen and data compatibility fixtures through assigned owners
For a real copied complete package outside repository, run existing packaged guarded acceptance

coverageQualification: The existing activity-rail harness hides windows and does not capture screenshots; geometry assertions do not count as visual review.
It uses Windows-style PATH and executable expectations; this Linux environment is not treated as equivalent Windows GUI execution.
Actual source-bound app.asar/package inventory is required before clearing the package-specific Canvas exclusion or WASM inclusion conditions.
Migration fixtures and any product fixes remain with services/native/CLI owners; this preparation does not invent or modify accepted user state.
plannedScenarios: 1360x900 and 900x650 activity rail, titlebar, shared sheet, keyboard focus, glass materials and light/dark surfaces
Kernel/settings/plugins round trips and independent unsent drafts
Unicode/space-containing workspace paths, duplicate search tokens, empty files, file watch and stable sorting
Group create/archive/order; split drag/editor restore/restart via public persistence flows
Packaged plugin/workspace/media smoke and isolated installer uninstall/reinstall behavior after package exists
